title: SkyraQueryCursorV1
description: Internal structure for signed, tamper-evident pagination cursors in Skyra LogHub Query Service.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the last returned log event.

event_id.description: RFC 4122 UUIDv4 of the last returned log event.

segment_id.description: Filename of the archive segment containing the tie-break record.

record_offset.description: Zero-indexed record offset inside the archive segment.

sort_direction.description: Sorting direction bound to the query.

query_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest of normalized query parameters to prevent cursor reuse across differing queries.

tenant_id.description: Authorized tenant ID bound to the cursor.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the cursor was issued, used for expiration checks.

signature.description: Server-side HMAC-SHA256 signature over the payload fields.
